summary: A 1939 camp with a crow's nest on Pritchard Peak, abandoned in 1941. A 2024 visit found no remains of the camp.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1941; a 2024 visit found no remains of the camp.

visit.trail_note: Listed as hike-in; the old road is overgrown.

events.note: Visit found no remnants of the camp and no tree identifiable as the crow's nest

evidence.supports: tree used as a crow's nest, not found
evidence.quote: we could not locate an actual tree used as a
While the road is still on the map, it is overgrown

evidence.supports: no remains of the camp found
evidence.quote: we could not find remnants of the actual camp

evidence.supports: only finds were braided cable and beer cans
evidence.quote: The only find was a piece of braided cable

evidence.supports: writers doubt a vehicle has reached the top in 20 to 30 years

evidence.supports: flat spots near the top that could have held a camp
evidence.quote: There are several flat spots at the top

corrections.why: Both the firelookout.com page and the Association list describe a camp with a crow's nest, and the Association lists the type as Crowsnest
The Association list gives the status Abandoned, not Gone

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 4424 feet and Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 4400 feet; the story reports both and does not choose.
Idaho Fire Lookouts spells the name Prichard Peak; firelookout.com and the Association list use Pritchard Peak. The record keeps Pritchard.

notes_for_editor: Idaho Fire Lookouts spells the name Prichard; story keeps Pritchard. Elevation disagrees (4424 vs 4400 feet); both are reported. Record kind 'platform' and status 'gone' differ from the sources; corrections proposed. No source gives an access level, so no access key is set; 'Hike-In' is used for visit. The 2024 description is first-hand from the Idaho Fire Lookouts writers and not independently checked. Record coordinates match the Association list.
